notes.title: Can No One Hear Me? OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h1]PoppKeys Games' first release is officially live![/h1]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45388118/b101ff6d11a72f28be8f4a2d930d349871b374b5.png[/img]
Can No One Hear Me? is available for the discounted price of [i][b]$1.50[/b][/i]!

Its a silly game and I really hope you have as much fun with it as I have over the course of its development. What started out as a "what if" amongst friends has turned into something I consider fairly charming, often frustrating, and perfectly stupid.

Personally, my favorite aspect of the game isn't even so much playing it as it is watching others play it. So get those streams up! If you'd like to share some fun clips of you and your friends trying to be heard, or really any feedback at all, please reach out to [url=https://poppkeysgames.com/contact/]contact@poppkeys.games[/url] and be sure to leave a review on Steam.

I'd love to hear what you think!

Also, I fully intend on furthering the development of this project. I'd really like to expand on the multiplayer, hopefully some day adding in 3 or 4 player matches. While it isn't "early access" development will continue on for a long while. So if you have any ideas for something you'd like to see in the game or run into any issues that need addressing, definitely let me know!

Thank you so much for your interest and support, and I genuinely hope you enjoy Can No One Hear Me?

-Hayden
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45388118/9333965dcdfa3b420424fae9f14516a05f3bc4b8.gif[/img]
